shortDescription: UPSSSC State Rural Development Institute Senior Instructor Cadre Main Examination 2026 for 132 posts. Apply online from 14 September to 05 October 2026 under Advt. No. 21-Exam/2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the notification for the State Rural Development Institute Senior Instructor Cadre Main Examination 2026 under Advt. No. 21-Exam/2026 for 132 posts.

The application window is open from 14 September 2026 to 05 October 2026. The form correction deadline is 12 October 2026. Candidates should complete the application on the official UPSSSC portal after checking the post-wise qualification and experience requirements.

Important dates and fee

  • Application begins: 14/09/2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 05/10/2026
  • Correction last date: 12/10/2026
  • Mains exam: As per schedule
  • Fee: Rs. 25 for UR/OBC/EWS, SC/ST and PH candidates

Post-wise eligibility overview

  • Agricultural Engineering: Agriculture Engineering with 50% marks and 3 years of experience
  • Plant Protection, Horticulture and Agronomy: relevant B.Sc. Agriculture / Horticulture with 50% marks
  • Animal Husbandry: B.Sc. or M.Sc. Animal Husbandry with 50% marks
  • Women Welfare: B.Sc. Home Science, Home Economics or Nutrition/Dietetics with 50% marks
  • Cooperation, Panchayat and Soil Science: relevant agriculture, economics, commerce, sociology or agriculture qualification as notified
  • Agriculture: Master's degree in Agriculture with 55% marks
  • Production: Diploma in Agricultural, Mechanical, Electrical or Civil Engineering with required experience
  • Public Health: Degree with a State Government-recognized Sanitary Inspector certificate

Read the complete notification for exact eligibility, experience, age limit, selection procedure, syllabus and pay scale before applying.
